{{Quote|It isn't as if we were kidnapping people from their homes. These creatures are specifically bred for agricultural work. If it weren't for our farming they wouldn't be born at all, you know. And Karfeddion is in the midst of severe economic depression.|[[Theala Vandron Jr.|Theala Vandron]]|<ref name="CotJ" />}}
'''Karfeddion''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[House Vandron]]. A large bountiful world, rich with plantations and ranches, it was used as a breeding ground for [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of various [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Ossan]]s, [[Balinaka]], and [[Human/Legends|Humans]].

At some point during one of the conflicts between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], prior to the [[Invasion of Ossus]], a military confrontation took place on Karfeddion in which the Jedi [[Dazh Ranos]] and another [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] Jedi were a part of. They had met in a trench and shared their rations.<ref name="You've brought the Jedi back">{{TORcite|type=message|You've brought the Jedi back|Dazh Ranos}}</ref>

Outsiders were banned in order to quell abolitionist discourse against slavery.<ref name="TEA" />
